method.stack_handoff: synchronous Wasm import trampolines; snapshots restored after JSPI resumes, never in Promise reactions
method.memory: parked_spills counts JS snapshots only; process_memory: three isolated Node --expose-gc processes per task count, 64 task warmup, GC before baseline/parked/after. RSS is coarse resident-process growth including engine/JIT pages; serial variants have one active I/O plus queued calls
method.timing: build/probes finish first; immediate: 512 JS submissions per batch, alternating paired 11x4096 tasks after warmup; delayed: 16 tasks, two 5ms timers, 2 warmups + 5 samples
